text.name: Oricorio

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Lesson in Zeal
abilities.text: All of your Fusion Strike Pokémon take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Lesson in Zeal Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Glistening Droplets
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

attacks.name: Energy Mix
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Fusion Strike Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Psychic Leap
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cross Fusion Strike
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your Benched Fusion Strike Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Max Miracle
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

rules.label: VMAX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Melodious Echo
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Fusion Strike Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

text.name: Escape Rope
effect: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, they don't switch Pokémon.)

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Crystal Cave
effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may heal 30 damage from each of their {Metal} Pokémon and {Dragon} Pokémon.

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Path to the Peak
effect: Pokémon with a Rule Box in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Double Turbo Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless}{Colorless} Energy.
The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 20 less damage to your opponent's Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.name: Switch Cart
effect: Switch your Active Basic Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, heal 30 damage from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Box of Disaster
effect: If the Pokémon V this card is attached to has full HP and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put 8 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

effect: The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power on this card.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Lost City
effect: Whenever a Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is Knocked Out, put that Pokémon in the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.)

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Lost Vacuum
effect: You can use this card only if you put another card from your hand in the Lost Zone.
Choose a Pokémon Tool attached to any Pokémon, or any Stadium in play, and put it in the Lost Zone.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Boss's Orders
effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Choice Belt
effect: The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon V (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.text: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

text.name: Judge
effect: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Nest Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Pal Pad
effect: Shuffle up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Iono
effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Fusion Strike System
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have as many cards in your hand as you have Fusion Strike Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Techno Blast
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Ultra Ball
effect: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.
Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Battle VIP Pass
effect: You can use this card only during your first turn.
Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Cram-o-matic
effect: You can use this card only if you discard another Item card from your hand.
Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Elesa's Sparkle
effect: Choose up to 2 of your Fusion Strike Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Fusion Strike Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Power Tablet
effect: During this turn, your Fusion Strike Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Fusion Strike Energy
effect: This card can only be attached to a Fusion Strike Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Fusion Strike Pokémon, discard this card.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to the Pokémon this card is attached to.
